integrity: The exact all-parameter theorem has an analytic proof; the standalone random-gradient diagnostics are supportive finite checks, not a proof or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Real finite-dimensional \(\ell_p\) only, 1<p<infinity; arbitrary nonzero finite-support line generator. Quantifies nearest-point projection, not arbitrary linear projections. No complex, nonatomic or infinite-support assertion; earlier exact all-weight formulations not excluded with certainty.
title: Sharp Lipschitz moduli of weighted best-line projections in real \(\ell_p^n\)
